title: Love Contigo--Not the Fake Marble
text:
Love Contigo--Not the Fake Marble. I picked up the marble contigo mug, as I always seem to need more of these. I really love these coffee mugs and find they leak less often than any other mug I've owned. You do have to be pretty careful of the plastic plug that locks the drinking hole and of the rubber ring on the inside of the lid. I wouldn't even try to take them out, as they are impossible to put back in. If they are not in correctly, then you get leaking.

Overall, I love these mugs, but the plastic sheet that looks like marble around it is pretty fake looking (obviously). It's fine, but I'll stick to plain colors in the future.

description: Enjoy a leak proof day with the Contigo SNAPSEAL Byron Vacuum Insulated Stainless Steel Travel Mug, 24 oz. The lid’s SNAPSEAL technology is designed for an easy one handed drinking experience, even during your morning commute. Pop the top to drink your caffeinated beverage of choice. There’s no lid to unscrew or remove. Just make sure to snap it closed when you’re done sipping to seal the leak proof lid. Thanks to THERMALOCK vacuum insulation, your new all day companion keeps liquids hot up to 9 hours or cold up to 21.
